question: Which goddess must knowledge seekers always serve devotedly?
premises: Seekers of knowledge should always serve her
She is Kamalā, beloved of Viṣṇu
Service to her is prescribed for those desiring knowledge
inference: Kamalā, beloved of Viṣṇu, is the goddess to be always served by seekers of knowledge.
plain_english: Kamalā, beloved of Viṣṇu, should always be served by those who seek knowledge.
